name: Kamimachi
tagline: Shibuya in 24 minutes and Shinjuku in 27 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Tokyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 41 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 24 minutes to Shibuya and 45 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 34.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 34.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 32.2 m to 39.2 m, a difference of 7.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. The station itself is inside the projected area, but few of the points around it are. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 9 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is さくら会世田谷中央病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 菊池外科病院, about 16 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Setagaya Line.
congestion: The ministry's congestion survey does not publish figures for Tokyu Setagaya Line. It covers the major commuter stretches, and this line is not among them.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. a small projected flood depth and schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Kamimachi is ahead on lower rent, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kamimachi. It is served by the same lines as Kamimachi. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥7,000 more at Setagaya.
